summary: Completed comprehensive frontend regression testing of Rahaza Travel ERP redesign. All features tested successfully including login flows for 3 roles (owner, ops_admin, driver), sidebar collapsible groups, navigation, RBAC visibility rules, Users page CRUD, coming-soon placeholders, logout, and public site. UI redesign to 'Kain Nusantara' aesthetic verified: white glass sidebar, azure-blue active states, iOS-style KPI cards, Bahasa Indonesia UI.
